title: Smoking in public places
question: Where is smoking prohibited in Poland?
short_answer: Smoking is banned indoors and in many public outdoor spaces.
conditions: Banned in all indoor public spaces (restaurants, bars, offices, shops)
Banned in public transport (buses, trams, trains, stations)
Banned in parks designated as smoke-free zones
Banned near playgrounds and schools (at least 10m)
Banned in healthcare facilities and hospitals
Smoking allowed in designated smoking areas
penalties: Fine: 500 PLN for smoking in prohibited areas
Business owners face fines of 2000 PLN for allowing smoking on premises
